summary: Frontend-only test of the new three-column doctor Home (/app) at 1920, 1280, 768 and 390, with the browser clock fixed at 10:00, 10:25, 10:40 and 22:00 and also installed (advancing) from 10:00. All requested features work. oggi-vaccines, oggi-bilanci and oggi-pill have count 0. At 1920: agenda x=272 w=498, next-bar x=802 w=315 (start button 240px, card 260px), summary x=1149 w=498, Vera under it at y=531. All three columns start at y=283. At 1280: 438/276/438, same row y=283, no overflow. Sticky: after scrolling the agenda (scrollY 326, the most the page can scroll at 1080h), the agenda moved to y=-43 while next-bar stayed at y=128. At 768: next-bar spans full width (728), with button and card centred. Agenda (x=20, w=352) and summary/Vera (x=396, w=352) sit side by side at y=752. At 390: single column in the order next-bar 257, summary 674, agenda 914, Vera 2067. scrollWidth is 390, so no overflow. Card content at 10:00: 'PROSSIMO PAZIENTE', Francesco Bruno, '6 mesi · Bilancio 6° mese · avvio svezzamento', '10:15 · tra 15 min'. At 10:25 the pill reads '10:15 · in ritardo di 10 min'. At 10:40 it reads 'in ritardo di 25 min'. At 22:00 it reads 'in ritardo di 11 h 45 min', as per the user's choice. Live update: with clock.install at 10:00, after run_for 5 min the pill changed to 'tra 10 min' without a reload. The Provincia filter shows Alice Conti '15:00 · tra 4 h 35 min' (no allergies). The allergies and empty states were checked by changing the GET /api/appointments response in the browser only (no DB change). With Bruno marked completato, the next patient is Ginevra Marino with oggi-next-allergies 'Allergie' (title 'Acari della polvere'), '11:00 · tra 20 min'. With everything completato, oggi-next-empty reads 'Nessun'altra visita oggi'. Vera: href https://www.verahealth.ai, target _blank, rel 'noopener noreferrer'. Title, description and note text are as specified. The Avvia MantAI button opens the consultation with consult-preselected-name = Francesco Bruno, and consultation-close-btn closes it. oggi-next-folder-btn opens the passport overlay (20 passport-* elements). The messages tile goes to /app/messaggi. Day and night mode are both readable.

issues: The time pill (oggi-next-when) wraps to 2 lines when it shows a delay or a long wait, e.g. '10:15 · in ritardo di / 10 min' and 'in ritardo di / 11 h 45 min', because the card is 260px wide and also holds the 'Cartella →' link. Consider whitespace-nowrap, a shorter label or a smaller font.
The card's computed border-radius is 14px instead of the requested 16px (rounded-2xl is overridden by the theme). Very minor.
The meta line wraps to 2 lines ('6 mesi · Bilancio 6° mese · avvio / svezzamento'). This is acceptable; the brief shows '…', so line-clamp-1 or truncate could be used if a single line is wanted.

action_items: Optional: stop the oggi-next-when pill wrapping (whitespace-nowrap / shrink-0) in the 260px card
Optional: make the next-card radius exactly 16px if required
critical_code_review_comments: OggiScreen: the next patient is the earliest not-done visit of today in the current filter (today.find(!isDone)). This matches the user's choice.
NextCard has no visible-label fallback when next.patient_id is null (free visit): the folder button is hidden. That is fine.
useNow uses a 30s interval and was verified to update the pill.
seed_data_creation: None. No data was modified; the allergy and empty states used browser-side route fulfilment of GET /api/appointments only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Block **/ap.emergent.sh/** and **/assets.emergent.sh/** before goto. Use page.clock.set_fixed_time. With page.clock.install, run_for of 5 min worked but run_for of 20 min hung the script (wall-clock timeout); keep run_for short. To mock appointments: capture the real GET /api/appointments response (an array) via expect_response at login, then route.fulfill a modified copy. route.fetch inside the handler returned a non-list dict and broke the page. The theme toggle has several copies; use '[data-testid=theme-toggle-btn]:visible'.
